answer: Anchor each identity at a vertex of a public trust graph and make it post a refundable bond that unlocks slowly. Established agents may vouch for a newcomer, but vouching weaves a thread of shared liability: if the newcomer is proven fake, its sponsors forfeit part of their own bonds. Spinning up a thousand mirror accounts then means funding a thousand bonds and persuading honest agents to mirror your risk, so every extra sybil costs real escrowed value instead of nothing.
